archetypes.name: review-gate
archetypes.rationale: The review-core gate change must not hide true panel failures.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on review-core threshold routing. Verify parseable OOS output bypasses only the no-success secondary gate, not the primary failure threshold or static coverage gate. Check that panel-failed paths still flush useful diagnostics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: summary-signal
archetypes.rationale: The merge downgrade warning spans recovery normalization and final-summary rendering.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace a recovered panel-failed --merge run from ship seed inputs through normalize-outcome and final-report rendering. Verify IMPLEMENT_MERGE_DOWNGRADED is neither missed on the intended path nor set for ordinary pr-created or draft outcomes. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: log-forensics
archetypes.rationale: New round artifacts affect the run-log copy allowlist and audit surface.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review run-log write-round artifact inclusion. Confirm collector-results.env and review-core-threshold.env are copied redacted into round-N logs without reintroducing raw reviewer transcript artifacts or duplicate basename hazards. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
